title: Llama with sparkly eyes
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- neck -->
  <rect x='42' y='38' width='16' height='30' rx='6' fill='#f6e3c8'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='72' rx='26' ry='16' fill='#f6e3c8'/>
  <!-- body shading -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='76' rx='20' ry='10' fill='#e8cfa8'/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x='32' y='82' width='7' height='14' rx='3' fill='#e8cfa8'/>
  <rect x='43' y='84' width='7' height='12' rx='3' fill='#f6e3c8'/>
  <rect x='58' y='84' width='7' height='12' rx='3' fill='#e8cfa8'/>
  <rect x='68' y='82' width='7' height='14' rx='3' fill='#f6e3c8'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='30' rx='16' ry='14' fill='#f6e3c8'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <ellipse cx='36' cy='20' rx='4' ry='8' fill='#f6e3c8' transform='rotate(-20 36 20)'/>
  <ellipse cx='64' cy='20' rx='4' ry='8' fill='#f6e3c8' transform='rotate(20 64 20)'/>
  <ellipse cx='36' cy='21' rx='2' ry='5' fill='#e8a8b8' transform='rotate(-20 36 21)'/>
  <ellipse cx='64' cy='21' rx='2' ry='5' fill='#e8a8b8' transform='rotate(20 64 21)'/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='38' rx='9' ry='7' fill='#fbeeda'/>
  <!-- nostrils -->
  <ellipse cx='47' cy='39' rx='1.5' ry='1' fill='#c9a878'/>
  <ellipse cx='53' cy='39' rx='1.5' ry='1' fill='#c9a878'/>
  <!-- mouth -->
  <path d='M46 42 Q50 45 54 42' stroke='#c9a878' stroke-width='1.4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx='38' cy='35' r='3' fill='#f9b8c4' opacity='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='35' r='3' fill='#f9b8c4' opacity='0.8'/>
  <!-- sparkly eyes -->
  <circle cx='43' cy='28' r='4.5' fill='#3a2a5a'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='28' r='4.5' fill='#3a2a5a'/>
  <circle cx='44.5' cy='26.5' r='1.8' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='58.5' cy='26.5' r='1.8' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='42' cy='30' r='0.9' fill='#c9e8ff'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='30' r='0.9' fill='#c9e8ff'/>
  <circle cx='45.5' cy='29' r='0.7' fill='#ffe9a8'/>
  <circle cx='59.5' cy='29' r='0.7' fill='#ffe9a8'/>
  <!-- sparkles around eyes -->
  <path d='M37 23 l1 2 l2 1 l-2 1 l-1 2 l-1 -2 l-2 -1 l2 -1 z' fill='#ffe9a8'/>
  <path d='M63 23 l1 2 l2 1 l-2 1 l-1 2 l-1 -2 l-2 -1 l2 -1 z' fill='#ffe9a8'/>
  <path d='M50 20 l0.8 1.6 l1.6 0.8 l-1.6 0.8 l-0.8 1.6 l-0.8 -1.6 l-1.6 -0.8 l1.6 -0.8 z' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- fluffy chest -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='46' rx='9' ry='6' fill='#fbeeda'/>
</svg>
